description: This file defines an API client module for interacting with project-related endpoints of a backend service. It provides the function getProjectsSummary to fetch summarized project data within specified date ranges or custom periods, using shared utility functions for API communication and authorization.

methods.name: getProjectsSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches project summaries based on given parameters such as range and custom date range, includes organization id in headers, and returns summarized data with buckets.
